title: Executive Order No. 151, s. 2021
text:
MALACANAN PALACE
MANILA

BY THE PRESIDENT OF THE PHILIPPINES
EXECUTIVE ORDER NO. 151

APPROVING THE NATIONWIDE IMPLEMENTATION OF THE ALERT
LEVEL SYSTEM FOR COVID-19 RESPONSE

WHEREAS, Article ||, Section 15 of the Constitution declared it a policy of the
State to protect and promote the right to health of the people;

WHEREAS, the Coronavirus Disease 2019 (COVID-19) pandemic has
severely impacted the lives of individuals and families worldwide, especially the most
vulnerable sectors of society;

WHEREAS, Section 6 of Republic Act (RA) No. 11332, otherwise known as the
"Mandatory Reporting of Notifiable Diseases and Health Events of Public Health
Concern Act," authorizes the Department of Health and its local counterparts to
enforce rapid containment, quarantine and isolation, disease prevention and control
measures, and other response activities for events of public health concern;

WHEREAS, Section 7 of RA No. 11332 authorizes the President to declare a
State of. Public Health Emergency in case of epidemics of national/international
concern that threaten national security, and to mobilize governmental and
nongovernmental agencies to respond to the threat;

WHEREAS, the President, through Proclamation No. 922 (s. 2020), declared
a State of Public Health Emergency throughout the Philippines due to COVID-19, and
through Proclamation No. 929 (s. 2020), placed the entire Philippines under a State of
Calamity for a period of six (6) months or until lifted or extended as circumstances may
warrant;

WHEREAS, Proclamation No. 1021 (s. 2020) extended the declared State of
Calamity for a period of one (1) year, or until 12 September 2021, and thereafter,
Proclamation No. 1218 (s. 2021), further extended the State of Calamity until 12
September 2022;

WHEREAS, Executive Order (EO) No. 112 (s. 2020) imposed Enhanced
Community Quarantine and General Community Quarantine in certain areas of the
Philippines and adopted the Omnibus Guidelines for the Implementation of Community
Quarantine in the Philippines (Omnibus Guidelines);

THE PRESIDENT OF THE PHILIPPINES
 
WHEREAS, EO No. 112 authorized the Inter-Agency Task Force for the
Management of Emerging Infectious Diseases (IATF) to impose, lift or extend a
community quarantine in Provinces, Highly Urbanized Cities (HUCs), and Independent
Component Cities (ICC);

WHEREAS, the Omnibus Guidelines has since been amended by IATF so as
to provide for the following community quarantine classifications: Enhanced
Community Quarantine, Modified Enhanced Community Quarantine, General
Community Quarantine, and Modified General Community Quarantine;

WHEREAS IATF Resolution No. 136-A (s. 2021) approved the shift in the policy
of classifying Provinces, HUCs and ICCs for purposes of community quarantine and
adopted the Alert Level System for identified pilot areas of implementation, with the
National Capital Region (NCR) being identified as the initial pilot area of
implementation;

WHEREAS, on 13 September 2021, the IATF issued its Guidelines on the
Implementation of Alert Levels System for COVID-19 Response in Pilot Areas, and
adopted amendments thereto in succeeding resolutions;

WHEREAS, the IATF has expanded the pilot implementation of the Alert Level
System to select Provinces, HUCs and ICCs across the Philippines;

WHEREAS, the IATF, through Resolution No. 146-F (s. 2021) dated 28
October 2021, recommended to the Office of the President the adoption of the Alert
Level System for all areas of the Philippines, through a phased nationwide rollout;

WHEREAS, while the current community quarantine classification system
under the Omnibus Guidelines has proven crucial in preventing the further spread of
COVID-19 in the country, the cumulative impact of the prohibitions and regulations
under that system on social, economic and other non-COVID-19 health objectives
cannot be overlooked;

WHEREAS, the nationwide shift to the Alert Level System would allow for the
reinvigoration of the economy through the opening of more sectors, while protecting
the people’s health through the continuous observance of public health protocols and
interventions and the heightened implementation of lockdowns in smaller areas, also
known as granular lockdowns;

NOW, THEREFORE, |, RODRIGO ROA DUTERTE, President of the
Philippines, by virtue of the powers vested in me by the Constitution and existing laws,
do hereby order:

SECTION 1. Adoption of the Alert Level System. The Alert Level System
(ALS) is hereby adopted for nationwide rollout, to be undertaken in four (4) phases.
The pilot areas in which the ALS is already being implemented as of the date of
effectivity of this Order shall be deemed as the first phase of the nationwide
implementation, while other regions shall follow in the succeeding phases, to wit:
 
Phase 1: NCR, Region III, IV-A, VI, VII, X and XI
Phase 2: Region I, VIII and XII
Phase 3: Region II, V, IX

Phase 4: Cordillera Administrative Region (CAR), Region IV-B, Region XII!
(CARAGA), and the Bangsamoro Autonomous Region in Muslim
Mindanao (BARMM)

The shift to Phase 2 may begin at any time after the effectivity of this Order, as
may be determined by the IATF, but not later than the end of November 2021. The
succeeding phases shall then commence every week thereafter until full nationwide
implementation.

SECTION 2. Guidelines on the Implementation of the ALS. The “Guidelines
on the Implementation of Alert Levels System for COVID-19 Response in Pilot Areas,”
with the amendments thereto approved by the IATF as of the effectivity of this Order,
is hereby adopted as the guidelines that shall be implemented and enforced in all
areas to be placed under the ALS in its nationwide rollout. The said Guidelines shall
be renamed accordingly to reflect its new status.

The IATF is hereby authorized to amend or modify such Guidelines as may be
necessary to achieve the objectives of the ALS, without need of further approval of the
President.

SECTION 3. Transitory Provision. Pending the full nationwide implementation
of the ALS, the Omnibus Guidelines for the Implementation of Community Quarantine
in the Philippines, approved through EO No. 112 (s. 2020), shall remain in effect in all
areas not yet placed under the ALS.

SECTION 4. Assistance and Cooperation of Agencies and LGUs. All
departments, agencies and instrumentalities of the government, including state
colleges and universities, government-owned or -controlled corporations, government
financial institutions, and LGUs are directed to render full assistance to and
cooperation with the IATF and mobilize the necessary resources for the
implementation of the ALS pursuant to this Order.

SECTION 5. Separability. If any part of this Order is held unconstitutional or
invalid, the other provisions not affected thereby shall remain in full force and effect.

SECTION 6. Repeal. EO No. 112 (s. 2020) shall be deemed repealed once all
areas of the country are placed under the ALS. All other orders, rules, regulations and
issuances, or parts thereof, which are inconsistent with this Order are hereby repealed,
amended or modified accordingly.
 
SECTION 7. Effectivity. This Order shall take effect immediately upon
publication in the Official Gazette or a newspaper of general circulation.

DONE, in the City of Manila, this11 dby of November in the year of Our Lord,

Two Thousand and Twenty-one.

By the President:
